proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1387 ālīyate explicitly gives Prakrit allivaï hands over and Gujarati ālvũ give/pay. The selected Bhil al-/āl- paired simple giving responses match this regional family, with vowel quantity and past endings preserved. This is not an assumed change from the different āp- family; local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: āl, ālũ.
